pdfkit.bundle.js - PDFKit 0.20.2 and the packages it is built from, as one
self-contained ES module (vendored 2026-11-07 from
https://esm.sh/pdfkit@0.20.2/es2020/pdfkit.bundle.mjs, renamed .js so every web
server serves it as JavaScript). See VENDOR.md.

Every package below is under the MIT licence (full text once, below) except
@swc/helpers, which is under the Apache License 2.0 (notice at the end). The
browser build of PDFKit does not include the Adobe standard-font metrics, so
Adobe's AFM notice does not apply to this file.

  restructure                Copyright (c) 2015-present Devon Govett
  tiny-inflate               Copyright (c) 2015-present Devon Govett
  dfa, brotli, unicode-trie,
  unicode-properties         Copyright (c) Devon Govett (foliojs)
  fflate 0.8.3               Copyright (c) 2026 Arjun Barrett
  @noble/hashes, @noble/ciphers   Copyright (c) 2022 Paul Miller (https://paulmillr.com)
  clone                      Copyright (c) 2011-2015 Paul Vorbach <paul@vorba.ch>
  fast-deep-equal            Copyright (c) 2017 Evgeny Poberezkin
  base64-js                  Copyright (c) 2014 Jameson Little
